name: dge-firebase-tests
description: Tests for DGE's Firebase layer (security rules, OTP logic, WhatsApp client, auth UI).

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:donations-e2e
scripts.test:e2e: rm -f /tmp/dge-otp-echo.txt && cd .. && DGE_OTP_ECHO_FILE=/tmp/dge-otp-echo.txt tests/node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project dge-test "cd tests && node --test e2e.spec.js"
scripts.test:donations-e2e: cd .. && tests/node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore --project dge-test "cd tests && node --test donations-e2e.spec.js"
